description: The supplied image is not a scientific figure at all: it is the standard Crossref "Check for updates" publisher badge, reproduced at low resolution (roughly square, ~150 px). It consists of three graphic elements on a light grey/white ground inside a thin rounded grey frame: (i) an open circular ring drawn as two overlapping arrow segments, one blue-grey and one yellow, forming a clockwise rotating loop; (ii) a solid crimson-red ribbon/bookmark shape with a notched (swallow-tail) bottom edge, centred inside the ring; and (iii) the two-line sans-serif text "Check for" / "updates" printed in dark grey below the ring. There are no axes, no units, no scale bar, no data points, curves, spectra, micrographs, colour scales, legends or sample labels of any kind. The badge carries no caption in the extracted text and no numeric content. It conveys only the bibliographic fact that the article is registered for crossmark update checking; it therefore provides no microstructural, compositional, processing or property evidence about the Fe–Mn–C–Al low-density steel system discussed by the paper.
